name: hupi-vscode
description: Chat and inline edit inside VS Code, backed by your own HUPI memory gateway instead of a vendor directly.

hupi.baseUrl.description: Root URL of your HUPI gateway (cmd/hupi), no trailing slash and no /v1 suffix — e.g. http://localhost:8787 or https://your-hupi-host.

hupi.model.description: Model/profile name to request, matching a profile in your HUPI deployment's providers.yaml. Leave blank to let HUPI use its default chat provider.

hupi.teamId.description: If set, routes requests through HUPI's team endpoint (/v1/team/{id}/chat/completions) instead of the private one — for a team-shared HUPI deployment (Tier 3).

hupi.oidc.issuerUrl.description: OIDC discovery base URL, e.g. https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0 — set this (and clientAppId, scope) to enable HUPI: Sign In instead of a pasted API key. Leave blank to use HUPI: Set API Key. See docs/OIDC.md.

hupi.oidc.clientAppId.description: The extension's OWN public-client app registration ID used to sign in — NOT the same value as your HUPI deployment's server-side HUPI_OIDC_CLIENT_ID (that one identifies the resource API, not this client). See docs/OIDC.md.

hupi.oidc.scope.description: The OAuth scope(s) to request when signing in, e.g. "api://<resource-client-id>/access_as_user offline_access openid profile". Must include offline_access or silent token refresh won't work.
